# Running httkqsprs

This is an example of running `httkqsprs` using a list of CICHEM and data from the pipelines database.  To run, you
must have an environment variable, `PIPELINES_CONN_STR`, set as demonstrated in `Renviron.example`.

Start the environment and load the package (in development mode):

```{r}
source('startup.R')
devtools::load_all(file.path(Sys.getenv("R_ROOT"), 'httkqsprs'))
```

Run the analysis using a small list of chemicals:

```{r}
chem.ids <- c(
  "CICHEM010017986",
  "CICHEM010028777",
  "CICHEM010057529",
  "CICHEM000200048",
  "CICHEM000200014"
)
out <- httkqsprs::generate_preds("June2026", chems = chem.ids)
```

View the outputs for $CL_{int}$:

```{r}
out$Clint
```

View the outputs for $F_{up}$:

```{r}
out$Fup
```

View the outputs for $P_{app}$:

```{r}
out$Papp
```
